mainEntity.name: How does Flipick work for agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agencies get a white-labeled Flipick tenant — their own branded platform with per-client brand kits, shared character and location libraries, and a Video Engine API. They brief, storyboard and approve on behalf of clients, then render the master film once and use VVP to produce all variants at a fraction of the master cost.

mainEntity.name: What does 'white-labeled' mean in the Flipick agency program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Flipick platform runs under the agency's own branding and domain. Clients see the agency's name, not Flipick's. Per-client brand kits, shared asset libraries, and separate billing make it possible to manage multiple client accounts from one platform without cross-contamination.

mainEntity.name: How is Flipick priced for agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: The platform runs on credits. Briefing, storyboarding and asset management are free. You're charged only when you render a master on AI. Variants cost a fraction of the master's credit cost and scale down further with volume. Indicative rates are available on request — confirm the current rate card before quoting a client.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of client work does Flipick support for agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Performance and A/B creative testing, e-commerce catalog video, multilingual localisation, and personalised data-driven video — all from one master film. Agencies can also push finished variants to channels like WhatsApp and Instagram directly from the platform.
